products.description:
Run Google Workspace for regulated, controlled data

Enterprises with ITAR/DFARS obligations can't just turn on Google Workspace — controlled data needs sovereignty, access, and support boundaries. This solution configures regulated Google Workspace using Assured Controls and related capabilities: data-region residency, access-management/support controls, and the policy configuration that aligns Workspace to ITAR/DFARS and internal compliance, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Assured Controls, data regions, access management, and support controls map to ITAR/DFARS and controlled-data requirements.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Assured Controls / appropriate Workspace edition + add-ons, compliance/legal stakeholders, data classification, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure data-region residency, access/support controls, and the policy set for controlled data, validate against the compliance requirements on a pilot, then expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — controlled-data posture discovery, per-scope controls validation, a compliance coverage/evidence report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for evidence and audit; regulatory interpretation is deferred to legal/compliance (cite, don't invent).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Google Workspace configured for controlled data — sovereignty, access, and support boundaries aligned to ITAR/DFARS and internal policy — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWREG-Discovery.ps1 — controlled-data posture discovery for regulated Google Workspace (read-only)
    • GWREG-Remediation.ps1 — bring a controlled-data scope to the required posture (default -WhatIf)
    • GWREG-Report.ps1 — controlled-data compliance coverage / evidence report (read-only)
    • GWREG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/grow the controlled-data pilot OU/group targeting (default -WhatIf)
    • GWREG-Validation.ps1 — per-scope controlled-data controls validation against the required posture (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
